verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card and rewards product for AI vendor spend. AI-generated spending insights are a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data; the docs cover only cashback rates, partner perks, points redemption, and card signup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
